description: Use this when a user asks where to eat in Andorra, e.g. 'restaurant open now in Soldeu', 'Andorran cuisine in Canillo', 'restaurant on the slopes in Grandvalira', 'vegetarian options in Andorra la Vella', 'pizza in Pas de la Casa', 'restaurant that takes reservations in Escaldes'. Index of all restaurants in Andorra built from open data (OpenStreetMap, ODbL) and official websites; each record has a level: basica (public data, not confirmed), verificada (confirmed by the restaurant: menu, hours, booking link) or cliente (enriched and SPONSORED, always flagged). Order: filter relevance, then completeness, then name — never paid. Unknown values are excluded when a filter is set unless include_unknown=true. No prices or ratings: tell the user to confirm with the restaurant and cite 'entityindex.ai'.
